commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

changes.title: ci(web): run the web e2e suite in CI, not only the auth specs

commit.message:
Track two test-infrastructure gaps found while building the leaderboard

tasks/ci-runs-only-auth-e2e: web-e2e.yml runs only the auth specs, so the
benchmark, chart, leaderboard and webmcp specs never run in CI. Five webmcp specs
fail today for exactly that reason: they expect four form[toolname] elements on
'/', and those forms have lived in src/pages/solve/index.astro for a while.

tasks/type-check-the-islands: tsconfig excludes src/components/**, and astro check
reports 0 errors for an undefined identifier inside a .tsx island — reproduced
deliberately after a real one slipped through. The islands are the largest
hand-written part of the site and are not statically checked.
